parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the toggle or rocker part of the switch, made of durable plastic, typically small and rectangular in shape.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the user interface for turning the electrical circuit on or off by toggling or pressing.
parts.Movement_description: It moves rotationally or pivotally around a small axis to change the circuit state.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base plate or housing of the switch, made of insulating plastic, rectangular in shape.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and insulation for the internal electrical components and the switch mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and fixed to a wall or panel surface.
